1879052895.name: Symphony of the Hopeful Heart
1879052895.desc: Increases Hope and Incoming Healing in a 5m area for 2m 30s.\n\nFurthermore, if an ally remains within the area for a few seconds, they will receive a buff to Resistance and Avoidance Penetration when they exit the area.

1879060191.name: Challenge the Darkness
1879060191.desc: You know how to goad your enemies into attacking you, making you their most threatening opponent, as well as raising your Guardian's Ward.

1879064287.name: Guardian's Defence
1879064287.desc: This stance focuses your defences on blocking attacks.

1879110239.name: Improved Song of Restoration
1879110239.desc: A song that makes an ally's heart glad again, removing some of the evil that currently plagues it.

1879115487.name: Dying Time!
1879115487.desc: The Dark Lord demands his due.  This skill has a high crit chance.

1879139039.name: Flayer
1879139039.desc:
Forsaking speed and surprise, your attacks are more devastating and your defence is increased. Cannot Stealth or Disappear when Flayer is active. 
 
 <rgb=#FF7700>Sudden Maul becomes Agonizing Maul. 
 
 Stealth becomes Brute. 
 
 Bestial Claws becomes Raking Claws. 
 
 Shadow Fangs becomes Brutal Fangs. 
 
 Eye Gouge becomes Eye Gash. 
 
 Disappear becomes Topple. 
 
 Howl from the Shadow becomes Howl of Aggression. 
 
 Shadow Pack becomes Pack Flayers. 
 
 Throat Rip Becomes Muscle tear. 
 
 </rgb>  <rgb=#00FFDD>Certain abilities have a small chance to activate a brute bonus.</rgb>

1879176287.name: Improved Knowledge of Cures
1879176287.desc: Cleanse multiple wounds, diseases, poisons, or fears from an ally.

1879198303.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Storm-raven)
1879198303.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879239263.name: Positive Thinking
1879239263.desc: Increases the rider's Morale regen in and out of combat while active.

1879243999.name: Measured Attack
1879243999.desc: Using the speed and momentum of your horse, you swing mightily against your opponent, attempting to weaken their defences.

1879245791.name: Muster in Caras Galadhon
1879245791.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Caras Galadhon in Lothlórien.

1879252319.name: Quick Attack
1879252319.desc: Boromir can make a quick stab with his sword that can surprise even the toughest foe.

1879302623.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Man-at-arms)
1879302623.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879366239.name: Spring Pheasant - Male
1879366239.desc: Brings out a male spring phesant to keep you company.

1879378143.name: Steed of Ered Mithrin
1879378143.desc: A steed inspired by the Grey Mountains Expedition.

1879408991.name: Expose (Bear)
1879408991.desc: Seeing a weakness in the enemy's defences, you exploit it, increasing your target's vulnerability to damage.\n\nMakes targets more vulnerable to Melee damage in Bear form.

1879417823.name: Steed of the Forest Spring
1879417823.desc: This steed brings to mind a living pool.

1879422303.name: Woodland Doe
1879422303.desc: Summons a woodland deer to keep you company.

1879463007.name: Frost Aurochs
1879463007.desc: Summons a frost aurochs to accompany you on your journeys.

1879479135.name: Tidal Dune-lurker
1879479135.desc: Summons a tidal dune-lurker to accompany you on your travels.

1879488735.name: Call to Ravens
1879488735.desc: Beseech a wild Raven to aid you.

1879494111.name: Guise of Durin VI
1879494111.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Durin VI. Don't delve too deep in search of treats!

1879495263.name: Memory of Justice
1879495263.desc: A Memory of Justice can be used to punish creatures of evil.

1879497695.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497695.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506655.name: Prepared: Frost Breath
1879506655.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, expel the chilling gelid wind from your lungs, dealing damage in a cone before you.

1879527391.name: Essence of the Vanquished
1879527391.desc: Use the Essence of the Vanquished to cleanse your Curse of the Gaurhoth.
